about: SEAM-273: SeamTrail reads this list from GitHub to tell a chat on an older plugin how to update it, and shows the same steps in Settings → Agents · MCP connector → Plugins. One entry per published plugin; each version must equal its plugin's own (tests/updates.sh checks). update: terminal commands run one after the other; where: where to run them; after: what to do next in the assistant; autoUpdate: how to have the assistant update it by itself (null when it cannot); tried: the steps were tried in the real assistant.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.where: in a terminal, in your repository's folder
claude-code.after: type /reload-plugins in the chat, or start a new chat
claude-code.autoUpdate: in Claude Code, type /plugin, open Marketplaces, pick seamtrail and choose Enable auto-update

cursor.name: Cursor
update: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/sharbuz2024/seamtrail-claude-plugin "$d" && mkdir -p ~/.cursor/plugins/local && rm -rf ~/.cursor/plugins/local/seamtrail-cursor && cp -R "$d/plugins/seamtrail-cursor" ~/.cursor/plugins/local/ && rm -rf "$d"
cursor.where: in a terminal (for a copy on your computer; from a team marketplace, Cursor fetches the newest when it starts)
cursor.after: run Developer: Reload Window in Cursor, or restart it
cursor.autoUpdate: on a team marketplace, an admin turns on Auto Refresh in the Cursor dashboard (Plugins & MCPs)

vscode.name: VS Code
vscode.where: in VS Code's Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift+P elsewhere)
vscode.autoUpdate: keep VS Code's setting extensions.autoUpdate on

codex.name: Codex
codex.after: start a new Codex session, and trust SeamTrail's changed hooks in /hooks

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.where: in a terminal (the first command in the copy of this repository you installed from)

kiro.name: Kiro
kiro.where: in a terminal, in your repository's folder
kiro.after: commit the files it lists and reopen Kiro (it replaces SeamTrail's own hook, steering and script files, so a change you made to them is lost)
